description: observation_id is unique in observations
scope and source-link joins keep one row per observation
every scope review row joins to one observation
sample rows equal scope review rows with include = true
sample contains no excluded or unreviewed observation
confirmed pairs joined to sample observations equal confirmed crosswalk rows
confirmed pairs repeat no old or new observation (no join multiplication)
every sample observation has exactly one match status row
sample observations per side = confirmed pairs + observations without a confirmed pair
unmatched statuses and labels equal outputs/unmatched_observations.csv from src/match.py
no unmatched observation is labelled completed, cancelled, closed, exited or new
every source file has one verified link whose SHA256 equals the manifest
manifest release_year, where supplied, equals the release_year of every observation in that file
every release has at most one snapshot date, and supplied dates are valid
every sample observation has one status row per mapped field of its release
every field status has an availability class
availability counts sum to the sample denominator for each release and field
every parsed start and end date is a valid calendar date
every parsed DCA rating is GREEN, AMBER or RED
no observation has ratings in both the external and SRO DCA fields
every parsed amount has at most 6 decimal places (exact in DECIMAL(38,6))
every parsed amount and published percentage casts to a number
annual variance keeps one row per observation
variance only where baseline and forecast are parsed with the same price-basis label
variance percentage is never infinite or NaN
variance percentage is null whenever baseline is not above zero
every calculated variance with a zero baseline is flagged
schedule and DCA comparisons keep one row per confirmed pair
end-date movement only for schedule-comparable pairs
every schedule-comparable pair has two valid end dates and a movement
DCA transitions only for DCA-comparable pairs with same-field ratings on the scale
a missing, withheld or blank rating never yields a transition
every DCA-comparable pair has a transition
no observation without a confirmed pair enters a schedule or DCA comparison
no pair is flagged monetary-comparable (cross-release money disabled)
every sample observation with a parsed DCA rating has one origin review row with the same field and rating
every origin evidence quote occurs verbatim in the commentary; only an unattributed rating may lack one
every DCA-comparable pair has verified origin of the same class in both releases
every pair has either a calculated comparison or exactly one exclusion reason
every pair excluded by the reviewer on scope cites scope or re-sequencing in its rationale
export row counts equal their source tables (joins preserve rows)
no excluded or unreviewed observation appears in any export
observation-level exports have unique observation_id
project_key is present and unique within each release in the observation export
a project_key observed in both releases is the canonical ID of a confirmed pair, and every pair key is on both observations
no published variance is negative (unsigned-magnitude convention holds)
reconciliation keeps one row per sample observation
published values equal the prepared source values (not overwritten)
calculated values equal the annual variance table (not adjusted to agree)
every sample observation has one recognised reconciliation status
coverage pair counts equal confirmed pair counts
coverage: eligible + excluded = confirmed pairs, outcomes sum to eligible, reasons sum to excluded
